name: 11413 · Laurelton, NY
findings: ZIP 11413 (Laurelton) has 148 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11413 (Laurelton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
88% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
